test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 01 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

409 ÷ 2 + 416 × 8 − 76 = ?
solution: 409 ÷ 2 + 416 × 8 − 76 Interchange operations: + ↔ − × ↔ ÷ Apply replaced operators and follow BODMAS rule
